title: PR Behavior Verification Review
description: Review payload produced by the verify skill for GitHub's pull request reviews API.

event.description: APPROVE only when the intended behavior was verified; COMMENT for a behavioral issue or incomplete verification.

body.description: Summary of the behavior, verification performed, results, and material gaps.

commit_id.description: Optional head SHA; the workflow always sets the pinned head when publishing.

comments.description: Inline behavioral findings or useful visual evidence on the PR diff.

path.description: Repository-relative path with a hunk in the PR diff.

body.description: Start a significant behavioral finding with '🔴 **CRITICAL:** '. Evidence without a finding needs no severity prefix.

line.description: Last line of the comment, inside a diff hunk on the chosen side.

start_line.description: First line of a multi-line comment; must be before line and in the same hunk.
